pr.title: refactor: standardize spelling of `ℵ₁` as `aleph1`
pr.body:
...in analogy to how `ℵ₀` is spelled `aleph0`. This matches what we do with `ω₁`.

Or should we be doing this the other way around, writing `aleph_one` for `ℵ₁`?

issue_comments.body: I think there should be a Zulip vote for this. I would have expected that we go the *other* way, potentially with `alephOne` instead of `alepha_one`. The point being that we generally don't use numerals in identifiers (cf. `cos_pi_div_two` for example).
